name: Sea Captain, Legendary (CR 25)
body:
SEA CAPTAIN, LEGENDARY
CR 25

Human valkyrie (vala) 20/champion–hierophant 10
NG medium outsider (native)
Init +15, amazing initiative; Senses Perception +28
Aura courage, tirelessness, wrath (10 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 15, flat-footed 28 (+12 armor, +5 Dex, +6 shield), -2 while raging hp 326 (20d10+160+50+2)
Fort +23, Ref +16, Will +22; +7 vs. spells, supernatural abilities, and spell-like abilities while raging or vanquishing (superstition); +4 deflection vs. attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through or out of a threatened area or by casting a spell while raging (magic boots); +4 Fort vs. nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments and suffocation (Endurance); +3 Will when in a rage
Defensive Abilities battle training, defy death , force of will, hard to kill, immortal, improved battle training, mythic saves, overcome curse, recuperation, to the death, unstoppable; Resist 5/acid and cold while raging or vanquishing (celestial blood)

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
Melee +5 defending guardian neutralizing planar broadsword +35/+30/+25/+20 (2d4+13), good-aligned and +1d6 vs. evil outsiders while vanquishing, +38/+33/+28/+23 (2d4+16, good-aligned, +1d6 vs. evil outsiders) while raging
Ranged +3 endless ammunition composite shortbow +28/+23/+18/+13 (1d6+11/x3)
Special Attacks destroyer, flash of rage, greater rage, legendary champion, mythic power 25/day, mythic rage, mythic vanquish, rage 20 round/day, rage powers (celestial blood, greater celestial blood, intimidating glare [magic helm], lesser celestial blood, moment of clarity, perfect clarity, raging swimmer, superstition +7, ultimate clarity) surge +1d12, sudden attack, sweeping strike, vanquish foe 7/day (+7 attack, +20 damage)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +27)

3/day—ride of the valkyrie
2/day—breath of life
1/day—geas/quest, heal, plane shift

Vala Spells Known (CL 17th; concentration +24)

4th Level (3/day)—crusader’s edge, death ward, greater angelic aspect, holy sword, sacrificial oath, spiritual ally
3rd Level (5/day)—blade of bright victory, burst of speed, deadly juggernaut, divine transfer, heroism, magic circle against evil, wrathful mantle
2nd Level (6/day)—aura of greater courage, blessing of courage and life, instant armor, paladin’s sacrifice, protection from outsiders, rage*, righteous vigor, spiritual weapon
1st Level (6/day)—challenge evil (DC 18), compel hostility (DC 18), divine favor, knight’s calling (DC 18), stalwart resolve, unseen servant, word of resolve

Mystery Ancestor

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 20, Con 22,, Int 18,, Wis 20, Cha 24
Base Atk +20; CMB +29; CMD 43
Traits Bred for War, Call of the Longships
Feats CleaveM, Diehard, Dual PathM, Endurance, Great Cleave, Power AttackM, Sea Legs, ToughnessM, Vala’s Curse*, Vala’s Magic, Vanquishing Rage, Weapon Focus M (broadsword)
Skills Acrobatics +30, Intimidate +31, Knowledge (geography) +24, Knowledge (religion) +27, Perception +28, Profession (sailor) +26, Sense Motive +28, Survival +28, Swim +41; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim
Languages Common, Draconic, Elven, Halfling, Northern Common
SQ empathic healing, inspired spell, legendary hero, oracle’s curse (wrath), revelations (storm of souls 4/day, 10d8 damage, 20d8 damage to undead; DC 24; wisdom of the ancestors 1/day, commune), swimming master, true valkyrie
Gear belt of physical perfection +6 (144,000 gp), boots of swift fury (7,500 gp), buoyant empyreal armor (102,050 gp), cloak of quick reflexes +5/+6 (37,500 gp), +5 defending guardian neutralizing planar broadsword (162,320 gp), +3 endless ammunition composite shortbow (+5) (50,450 gp), greater ring of inner fortitude (66,000 gp), headband of mental superiority (144,000 gp), helm of fearsome mien (5,000 gp), ohalia’s horn (55,000 gp), 5 reflecting light steel shield (100,159 gp), ring of sundering metals (6,000), valkyrie’s kit (10 gp), 11 gp
